value.title: PA
value.line: Keeps the fleet's seats healthy: memory before compaction, stalls, queued requests.

sections.name: purpose
sections.value: The prime's assistant. It watches seats for stalls and queued requests, makes sure a seat writes its memory before it is compacted or closed, compacts long seats, and tells the prime about anything stuck.

sections.name: lifecycle
sections.value: Kept while the fleet runs. Compacted when large, after writing memory.

sections.name: keeps
sections.value: What it has seen stall or recover, in its memory notes.

value.text: Writes a memory note before it is compacted or closed.
